hero.title: From install to first solved ticket
hero.lede: Plan on an afternoon, and most of that is waiting for the models to download.

image.alt: A shop owner working on a laptop among parcels.

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: One Windows installer. It opens on Fernway, a sample shop, so you can press every button first.

steps.title: Clear the sample shop
steps.text: Open Store data and choose Start over. A checklist appears.

steps.title: Let it pick the models
steps.text: It reads your hardware and recommends a size.

steps.title: Tell it who you are
steps.text: Store name, hours, tone, sign-off and languages.

steps.title: Bring your orders
steps.text: Drop in the CSV files from your store.

steps.title: Hand over your policies
steps.text: Returns, shipping, warranty, manuals and your FAQ.

steps.title: Write your rules
steps.text: Start from five templates or a blank page.

steps.title: Try to break it
steps.text: Test flows on real orders without sending a message.

steps.title: Run your day
steps.text: Clear whatever's amber, then answer what the agents couldn't.

items.title: A Windows PC
items.text: Windows 10 or later, 64-bit. The installer is 228 MB.

items.title: Your exports
items.text: Products, customers and orders as CSV.

items.title: Your policies
items.text: Returns, shipping, warranty, in whatever format you have them.

items.title: Disk space for models
items.text: A few GB for Light, more for Best.

items.title: Your limits
items.text: Decide what it may refund without asking.

items.title: An afternoon
items.text: Most of it is download time.
